name: rotation
summary: Count turns and rev/s of something spinning in the image plane: a fan, a wheel, a turntable.

hardware.camera: a fixed camera facing the rotation axis; the frame rate must exceed 2 x symmetry x the fastest rev/s (gamst recipe check rotation tells which); a GAMST 240 take for fast fans

measured: 2026-11-25: synthetic 240 fps 3-blade fans within 0.5% of the true turns (5, 12 behind a grill, 30 rev/s); a real 24 fps record clip 0.7% low against frame-rotation matching; a real 30 fps ceiling fan was at the sampling limit and is refused at a realistic speed; no human-counted real fan yet
